name: Shari Stilwell
summary: In Brill, Shari Stilwell trains Forsaken in the paladin's path. She is stationed in Tirisfal Glades, where the undead who endure the Light's pain learn holy and martial discipline.

sections.title: A Beacon in Brill
sections.body: In Brill, Shari Stilwell guides Forsaken who seek the path of holy warriors. The Light brings the undead excruciating pain, yet she trains those willing to endure it. She helps newcomers find their footing in Tirisfal Glades, through early training and the adjustments of Forsaken life. Those she guides seek a place within the Forsaken kingdom.

sections.title: Ties of the Stilwell Name
sections.body: Shari bears the same family name as Daphne, Merissa, and Jordan Stilwell, a renowned smith among the living in the southern kingdoms. Whether the fall of Lordaeron tore Shari from these kin, or whether their bond is only distant, remains unknown amid the Scourge's devastation.

faq.answer: Shari Stilwell is an undead paladin trainer in Brill, Tirisfal Glades. She guides Forsaken paladins through early martial and holy instruction as they learn to survive in Lordaeron.

faq.q: Where can Shari Stilwell be found?
faq.answer: Shari can be found in the town of Brill, just north of the Capital City ruins and the Undercity in Tirisfal Glades.

faq.q: Is Shari related to Jordan Stilwell?
faq.answer: Shari shares her surname with Jordan Stilwell, a famous human smith, and with Daphne and Merissa Stilwell. Their exact family connection is unknown, though the plague that destroyed Lordaeron may have severed it.

faq.q: Can Forsaken wield the Light as paladins?
faq.answer: The Holy Light brings intense pain and burning to the undead. Shari Stilwell guides determined Forsaken in the devotion and mental fortitude needed to wield its power alongside martial skill.

angles.text: As a Forsaken paladin beginning in Tirisfal Glades, you can find your primary trainer and mentor, Shari Stilwell, in Brill.
As an undead traveler, you see in Shari Stilwell how the Third War splintered families: she mentors the Forsaken while possible kin live far to the south.
